public_rationale: The arithmetic checks out: losing 35 million Plus subscriptions at $20 costs $700 million per month, while adding 109 million Go subscriptions at the assumed $5 adds $545 million, leaving $155 million. That is a calculation on the supplied premises. The original subscriber projections could not be verified through readable, sufficiently authoritative evidence, so the projection-based financial claim remains unresolved under the evidence rules. This does not identify a mathematical error.
limitations: The monthly gap is not a realized annual revenue loss or a measure of profitability.
The result excludes advertising and assumes every incremental Go subscription pays USD 5.

our_interpretation: This is a calculation about the reported scenario, not a forecast requiring subscriber growth to occur before the arithmetic can be assessed.
The ordinary unit is USD per month because both subscription prices are monthly.
Compare the lost gross monthly Plus subscription receipts with the additional gross monthly Go subscription receipts, using the stated 2025 and 2026 subscriber counts.
Exclude advertising, other products, operating costs, discounts, taxes and the timing of subscriptions within the year.
The historical-largest acquisition-campaign aside is not established by this calculation and receives no endorsement.
The observation period concerns the scenario reported by the post date; the financial comparison itself is between the stated 2025 and 2026 subscriber levels.
criteria.support_condition: The reported scenario establishes Plus counts of 44 million and 9 million and Go counts of 3 million and 112 million; at USD 20 and the assumed USD 5 per month, respectively, the difference in incremental gross monthly subscription receipts is USD 155 million.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified inputs for the same reported scenario, evaluated on the same monthly subscription-only basis, produce a materially different gap. Advertising revenue or a different assumed Go price does not contradict this conditional calculation.
